turns.text: Fingerpicking can be challenging but so rewarding once the muscle memory kicks in. I hope the call goes well, the lunch is tasty, and you have a great climb later!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I'm looking forward to it. Catch up with you later!
